title: turath-catalog authors
description: One row per author name form. Two people who share a name form are two rows when their death years differ; two name forms of one person are two rows that share a canonical_author_id.

author_id.description: Stable id: `a_` + first 10 hex digits of sha1(`author_key` or `author_key|death_ah`).

name_ar.description: The name by which the author is cited (shuhra), as on the editions.

full_name_ar.description: Full name (ism, nasab, kunya, nisba) when a source gives it.

death_ce_from.description: First Gregorian year that the Hijri death year overlaps.

death_ce_to.description: Last Gregorian year that the Hijri death year overlaps (equal to or one more than death_ce_from).

century_ah.description: Hijri century of death (from death_ah, else from a catalog record).

death_source.description: `shamela_book`: the Shamela author record of a Shamela book matched to one of the author's works; `author_table`: the same name's year on another of the author's books, or Shamela's author table when name and century agree.

death_confidence.description: `high`: every edition that gives a year agrees and the year is in the recorded century; `medium`: a single witness; `low`: the year is that of the author of a matched Shamela book whose name could not be matched to this row's name (the row may name that book's commentator, transmitter or editor).

n_works.description: Number of the author's works in the dataset.

wikidata_qid.description: Wikidata item of the author, through Wikidata's Shamela author id (P12435), with the death year checked.

canonical_author_id.description: The row that stands for this person (authors.author_id). Name forms that carry the same catalog author id in ext_ids and no conflicting death year («ابن الجوزي», «أبو الفرج ابن الجوزي») share one: the dated row with the most works. Equal to author_id for every other row. Group by it to count people rather than name forms.
